fields.summary: Firewall request: Kong API Gateway → AI Portal BFF
fields.description:
The Kong API Gateway in the integration zone needs to reach the AI Portal Backend-for-Frontend service on port 8443 (HTTPS) to forward authenticated API calls from external consumers.

Source: integration-kong-api-gateway
Destination: backend-ai-portal-bff
Protocol: HTTPS
Port: 8443
Justification: Required for Phase 2 CSP API rollout.

fields.summary: Firewall request: Batch Processor → Core Banking DB
fields.description:
Nightly batch reconciliation process running in the data platform zone must connect to the Core Banking Oracle DB on port 1521.

Source: data-batch-processor
Destination: corebanking-oracle-db
Protocol: TCP (Oracle Net)
Port: 1521
Justification: End-of-day batch settlement required for GL reconciliation.

fields.summary: Firewall request: External Web Portal → Internal Auth Service
fields.description:
The public-facing web portal in the DMZ requires outbound access to the internal LDAP/AD authentication service in the IDMZ on port 636 (LDAPS).

Source: web-portal-frontend
Destination: idmz-auth-service
Protocol: LDAPS
Port: 636
Justification: User authentication flow for HKMA staff portal login.
